row.proto: void Render_TextureStreaming_AddPreloadRequest(void *streamer, float *tex_entry, uint64_t unused, float priority, uint32_t hint_bits, float scale)
row.notes: Updates a streamed texture entry: merges/clears preload hint bits in byte +0x34 (bits 0..5, clear mask in hint_bits>>6), computes preload density from entry[8] times a per-hint factor (table 0x1458c3660), stores it in entry[10], scale in entry[11], raises density entry[2], priority entry[1] and deficit entry[0], sets atomic dirty bit at +0x24 and if newly dirty appends the entry to streamer vector +0x148 under SRW lock +0x590. Logs "PRELOAD REQUEST"/"PRELOAD RELEASE" on channels TEXTURE_STREAMING_PRELOAD_REQUESTS / _CLEAR_REQUESTS. Hook to force texture preloading.
